problem_text:
A logistics company must coordinate 10 delivery trucks to transport 10 different shipments across a distribution network.

Each shipment must follow a predetermined route through 10 different transfer stations, represented as pairs (Station, Handling time), where each pair specifies the station where the shipment must be processed and the time required for handling. The sequence of pairs indicates the mandatory order in which the stations must be visited.

Shipment details:
* S1 follows the route: (Station1, 2) → (Station6, 5) → (Station9, 7) → (Station7, 2) → (Station4, 8) → (Station3, 10) → (Station5, 6) → (Station8, 10) → (Station2, 6) → (Station10, 7)
* S2 follows the route: (Station2, 9) → (Station10, 2) → (Station1, 5) → (Station9, 7) → (Station5, 7) → (Station6, 5) → (Station3, 6) → (Station8, 8) → (Station4, 1) → (Station7, 4)
* S3 follows the route: (Station5, 10) → (Station6, 3) → (Station7, 1) → (Station8, 5) → (Station3, 10) → (Station1, 5) → (Station10, 10) → (Station4, 4) → (Station9, 9) → (Station2, 6)
* S4 follows the route: (Station9, 5) → (Station4, 7) → (Station10, 6) → (Station2, 6) → (Station5, 5) → (Station8, 7) → (Station6, 6) → (Station3, 4) → (Station1, 1) → (Station7, 7)
* S5 follows the route: (Station3, 8) → (Station6, 8) → (Station2, 9) → (Station8, 3) → (Station7, 9) → (Station5, 7) → (Station9, 2) → (Station4, 10) → (Station10, 10) → (Station1, 4)
* S6 follows the route: (Station8, 4) → (Station7, 4) → (Station6, 10) → (Station5, 7) → (Station2, 10) → (Station1, 9) → (Station9, 3) → (Station10, 3) → (Station3, 1) → (Station4, 4)
* S7 follows the route: (Station2, 4) → (Station1, 6) → (Station4, 7) → (Station5, 9) → (Station9, 7) → (Station6, 2) → (Station7, 6) → (Station8, 10) → (Station3, 2) → (Station10, 6)
* S8 follows the route: (Station7, 2) → (Station2, 6) → (Station6, 6) → (Station1, 5) → (Station10, 3) → (Station8, 8) → (Station3, 7) → (Station9, 4) → (Station5, 4) → (Station4, 2)
* S9 follows the route: (Station2, 2) → (Station7, 1) → (Station3, 8) → (Station4, 3) → (Station5, 4) → (Station6, 6) → (Station9, 10) → (Station8, 1) → (Station1, 2) → (Station10, 9)
* S10 follows the route: (Station9, 5) → (Station5, 9) → (Station3, 5) → (Station8, 7) → (Station7, 10) → (Station4, 6) → (Station1, 8) → (Station6, 5) → (Station2, 1) → (Station10, 1)

Once a shipment begins processing at a station, it must continue without interruption until completion, and each station can only handle one shipment at a time. The objective is to determine the processing sequence for all shipments at the stations so that the total completion time for all shipments is minimized.
